summary: A venue files suit days before an earlier alcohol cutoff takes effect.
realLife: A city moved the last call in one nightlife district from five in the morning to two for venues over a set size, citing the mostly residential area. One large club said it was singled out, claimed the rule would cost over two hundred jobs and filed suit to block it before it started. A resident worried about bartenders who earn their pay in the late hours. Other districts kept the later hour.
sources: CBS News Miami (Miami Beach, Florida), 'New alcohol sales ordinance to greet Miami Beach spring breakers', February 28, 2023: https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/miami/news/curtailed-alcohol-sales-to-greet-miami-beach-spring-breakers
